title: Family with Baby by Christmas Tree, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A classic post-war black and white snapshot capturing a young family posed together indoors for the holidays. A father in a dress shirt and necktie sits beside his wife, who holds a soft ball while balancing their young child in overalls on her lap. Behind them, a Christmas tree decorated with heavy strands of tinsel and glass ornaments stands in front of horizontal window blinds, embodying mid-century domestic celebration and the postwar baby boom era.
